complaint_text: Ration shop in Hadapsar Pune closed for the last 45 days. No grain distributed for priority cardholders.
I visited the Pune district fair price shop thrice this month. Store is constantly locked and shopkeeper refusing ration delivery.
Haven't received ration grain quota for 2 months in Pune area. FPS dealer claims stock unavailable.
Ration shop owner in Pune district charging extra money and not giving monthly rice allocation.
PDS ration distribution delayed by over 60 days across Pune center. Shop closed whenever visited.
